connectionId.description: A key-manager connection's id: a version 4 UUID the adding client mints, kept in lowercase.

mount.description: The KV mount to list in, as personal or secret/team; absent to list the mounts. OpenBao only.

path.description: The path under the mount to list, as harness; absent for the mount's top. OpenBao only.

vault.description: The vault whose items are listed, by name or id; absent to list the vaults. 1Password only.

item.description: The item in the vault whose fields are listed, by name or id; absent to list the vault's items. 1Password only.
